replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a bit of a mystery to me. While I appreciate its logic and structure, it never felt like my natural strength. My parents were highly educated in sciences, so there was pressure to excel, but I found myself drawn more towards literature and chemistry instead. It remains a subject I respect but don't feel deeply connected to.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. With my high neuroticism score, complex numbers or abstract concepts often trigger worry rather than curiosity. I remember feeling overwhelmed during exams, fearing failure more than wanting to understand the material. This anxiety sometimes made me avoid math-related tasks, preferring subjects where I felt more confident and in control.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. My experience with technology has been mixed. While I appreciate its potential, I often feel anxious about relying on tools I don't fully understand. In the past, I've used calculators or online resources for quick checks, but deep learning through AI felt too abstract and intimidating for my comfort level.
